name: Cadalso de los Vidrios (Spain)
description: White field with a red horizontal stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Cadalso de los Vidrios (quartered, winged arms with swords on red and lions on white).
history: The arms and flag of Cadalso de los Vidrios were approved on 18 July 1994, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 22 July 1994; the flag is a cloth of proportions two thirds.
